correctness.rationale: Exact algebra gives det(M)=1 and irreducibility of the characteristic polynomial X^3+X+1 modulo two. Direct matrix multiplication gives M^7=I+2B with det(B)=87 and M^14=I+4C with C=B+B^2 and det(C)=7569. The induction C_(j+1)=C_j+2^j C_j^2 makes every normalized lifting matrix invertible modulo two. This gives exact v2((M^(7*2^j)-I)v)=v2(v)+j+1 for nonzero state vectors. Counting valuation strata gives 7*8^j states and 4^j cycles of length 7*2^j. The embedded standard-library checker reproduces base identities, 14 matrix valuations and exhaustively verifies 37448 states at exponents 1..5. Finite tests are not used to prove the infinite range.

originality.rationale: Full textual source comparisons and multiple actual semantic database searches did not reveal this exact all-seed spectrum for the characteristic polynomial X^3-2X^2-X-1. The 2022 source defines the sequence but concerns perfect powers; the 2018 finite-group paper discusses selected generating-set periods, not the all-state valuation stratification. Nearby database theorems concern two-step Pell, a different Narayana companion matrix, or k-step Fibonacci rather than this order-three Pell map. The earlier distinguished-seed maximum period is acknowledged as prior; an unnoticed abstract matrix-orbit theorem remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: A general matrix congruence theorem with primitive modulo-two characteristic polynomial and odd normalized lifts may give this result as a specialization.
The accessible 2018 finite-group period paper has no observed all-seed cycle histogram, but other sequence-period literature could contain it.
The directly linked published database repository page could not be opened for full-text examination; its actual searchable abstract was compared, not misrepresented as a full-document inspection.
Absolute novelty cannot be inferred from a finite collection of sources or from searched index partitions.

value.rationale: A complete orbit census for every integer-seeded order-three Pell recurrence modulo every power of two is a natural invariant finer than a Pisano period. The uniform valuation rule classifies all 2^(3k) states and yields 4^j primitive cycles of length 7*2^j at every level, distinguishing short and long cycles and giving a closed total count. It is an infinite structural classification, not an arbitrary sample or a renamed two-step Pell result; it does not claim a general all-order Pell theorem.
